jobs.label: Sleeping
jobs.action: Sit curled comfortably, hands resting together, eyes closed throughout, tiny breathing and soft head settling. No sleep symbols.

jobs.label: Head pats
jobs.action: Stand with arms relaxed; lean head into an imagined head pat, close eyes with a delighted smile, gently rock the head, recover. No external hand.

jobs.label: Happy touch
jobs.action: Stand, bashful smile, hug scarf gently against chest, little shoulder wiggle, relax. Full coat and body, no new props.

jobs.label: Eating
jobs.action: Hold a small golden bread roll in both hands touching the torso; bring to mouth, take a little bite and chew happily, lower it. Bread always attached to hands; no crumbs.

jobs.label: Drinking
jobs.action: Hold one simple white mug in both hands against torso; raise to mouth, gently tilt to sip, blink, lower. Mug always touches hands; no steam or drops.

jobs.label: Talking
jobs.action: Stand front-facing; small expressive attached hand gestures near chest with six distinct gentle mouth shapes as if speaking, friendly eye blink; return to relaxed pose. No speech bubble.

jobs.label: Sitting idle
jobs.action: Sit cross-legged with coat draped naturally and hands on knees; blink and gentle breathing with tiny head tilt, relaxed friendly expression.

jobs.label: Stretching
jobs.action: Stand and perform a cozy full-body stretch: arms initially by sides, lift both arms overhead, reach up, little closed-eye yawn, lower arms. Keep boots on same floor baseline.

jobs.label: Celebrating
jobs.action: Stand, smile brightly, lift both small fists beside face in a victory gesture, brief happy knee bend and soft excited bounce, return. No stars or detached effects.

jobs.label: Reading
jobs.action: Sit and hold a compact dark brown book open with both hands close to body, look down to read, eyes scan, small page turn attached to book, thoughtful nod. No readable text.

jobs.label: Being carried
jobs.action: Show the same whole character dangling gently as if picked up by the coat collar: shoulders slightly raised, arms near torso, boots hanging below with little alternating leg kicks, surprised then amused smile. No external hand or hanger.

jobs.label: Resting
jobs.action: Sit with legs gathered and hands in lap, looking mildly tired, droopy eyelids and small sigh-mouth, tiny slow breathing, calm recovery. No sweat drops or illness symbols.

jobs.label: Looking around
jobs.action: Glance left, up, and right, blink and return.

jobs.label: Adjusting scarf
jobs.action: Tuck scarf, smile, and lower hands.

jobs.label: Sleepy yawn
jobs.action: Cover a yawn and settle back to neutral.
